items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: He played the second something under E.T. Thomas, because he knew how that second part would go with his tone. Did you all use music in the Banner Band? Oh, yes.

ctx.x: In the Banner Band, what part did Bunk play? I may be asking a lot of questions about Bunk, but he was a very close friend of mine and I admired him so much. I'm just interested in.

He played the second something under E.T. Thomas, because he knew how that second part would go with his tone. Did you all use music in the Banner Band? Oh, yes. Everybody was reading. Everything was reading. Oh, yeah. Everybody read that.
Did you play all the popular tunes? Did you play many?
